description.la: Allegorica expositio in Parabolas Salomonis libri tres, cum libello De muliere forti (Prov 31,10-31).
description.en-US: Bede's commentary on the Proverbs of Solomon in three books, with the separate treatise On the Valiant Woman (Prov 31:10-31), read as the Church. Latin text of Migne (PL 91-93); no public-domain English translation is known.
description.pt-BR: O comentário de Beda aos Provérbios de Salomão, em três livros, com o tratado separado sobre a Mulher Forte (Pr 31,10-31), lida como a Igreja.

sources.edition: Allegorica expositio in Parabolas Salomonis; De muliere forti on Latin Wikisource, from the Corpus Corporum TEI of Migne's Patrologia Latina.
sources.description: Wikitext removed; inline PL column numbers dropped; one file per book (or per part), chapter divisions kept as headings with their rubrics.
sources.tierEvidence: Eighth-century text in Migne's reprint of Giles: public domain.
